name: application-vehicle-spec-card
title: Vehicle Spec Card
description: A car listing card with a photo, certification badge, title, icon-labeled spec chips (mileage, fuel type, transmission), price, and a view-listing CTA.
useWhen: Automotive marketplaces or dealership inventory listings where each vehicle needs a photo, key specs, and a price at a glance.
The spec set (mileage, fuel type, transmission) is domain-specific and doesn't fit the generic `Product Card` field set.
avoidWhen: The item being listed isn't a vehicle — use `Product Card` for general retail listings instead.
You need a full detail page rather than a summary card — this component is a listing-grid tile, not a detail view.
responsiveBehavior: The card keeps a fixed aspect-ratio photo area at its container's width; spec chips wrap via flex-wrap onto additional lines on narrow cards rather than overflowing.
accessibility: Each spec chip pairs an icon with a text value (e.g. "18,240 mi"), not an icon-only badge.
The certification badge is text-based ("Certified"), not conveyed by badge color alone.
Price and the primary CTA sit in a clear visual hierarchy at the card's base, both reachable via standard tab order.

variants.title: Certified listing
variants.description: A 2023 Audi A4 Premium listing card with a photo, 'Certified' badge, VIN subtitle, mileage/fuel/transmission spec chips, price, and a 'View listing' button.
accessibility: Each spec chip's icon is paired with a text value, not icon-only.

variants.title: Certified listing (Dark)
variants.description: Vehicle spec card adapted for dark surfaces, including the photo placeholder gradient and chip backgrounds.
accessibility: Chip text, price, and the CTA button all meet WCAG AA contrast against the dark card background.
